name: week
title: Admissions desk this week
subtitle: Fictional demo when seeded. Internal records, no applicant rankings.

sections.title: Applications needing attention
sections.sql: SELECT external_id,name,intake,owner,desk_state,missing_materials,pending_reviews FROM application_desk WHERE outcome IS NULL ORDER BY due_on,external_id

sections.title: Reader workload
sections.sql: SELECT reader,count(*) AS pending,count(*) FILTER (WHERE overdue_days>0) AS overdue FROM reader_queue GROUP BY reader ORDER BY reader

sections.title: Offer follow-up
sections.sql: SELECT external_id,name,owner,offer_due_on FROM offer_followup ORDER BY offer_due_on

sections.title: Record controls
sections.sql: SELECT external_id,rule,finding FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY external_id,rule
